value.rationale: The third root-count moment is a natural local statistic in recent squarefree-value research. An all-prime, all-exponent, degree-independent exact formula reveals a parity-sensitive sharp square-root exponential growth rate, in striking contrast to the linear variance. This is a substantive rare-cluster law, not merely a small finite table or a reparametrization of the known \(p^2\) moment bound.
